findings.claim: Account-scoped display_id lookup and show? authorization; account/API/MFA callbacks present.

Account label CRUD manages label records: policy-scoped index, create/update, account-scoped id lookup, destroy plus asynchronous association removal; requires nested label title/description/color/show_on_sidebar. Conversation POST assigns label_list; templates wrap payload (independently verified A citations).
Spec covers unauthorized GET/POST and inbox-member successes, checking label substrings. Authenticated-denied access remains an unverified gap, not a proven defect.
